item.title: 苹果一大波智能家居新品曝光，最快下周发布
item.guid: 苹果一大波智能家居新品曝光，最快下周发布
item.description:
According to Bloomberg, Apple is co-developing a series of smart home accessories with LG, including wired video doorbells, smart locks, thermostats, temperature sensors, and indoor, outdoor, and floodlight cameras. 据彭博社报道，苹果正与 LG 共同开发一系列智能家居配件，包括有线视频门铃、智能门锁、恒温器、温度传感器，以及室内、室外和泛光灯摄像头。

These products will use the LG brand, with manufacturing and after-sales handled by LG, and will work with Apple's upcoming home hub, new HomePod mini, and Apple TV. 这批产品将使用 LG 品牌，制造和售后由 LG 负责，并与苹果即将推出的家庭中枢、新 HomePod mini 和 Apple TV 配合使用。

Some devices have already appeared in regulatory documents, with many accessories supporting Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Thread, and Matter. The smart locks also support UWB for automatic unlocking when approached. These accessories will not be available for several more months. 部分设备已出现在监管资料中，多款配件支持 Wi-Fi、蓝牙、Thread 和 Matter，门锁还支持 UWB，可实现靠近自动解锁。这批配件还要再等几个月才能买到。

Regarding touchscreen MacBooks, in the macOS 27.2 beta, long-pressing app icons in the Dock produces a slight magnification feedback, similar to the long-press effect on iPhones and iPads. 触屏 MacBook 方面，macOS 27.2 测试版中，长按 Dock 里的应用图标会出现轻微放大的反馈，类似 iPhone 和 iPad 上的长按效果。

Current reports point to two models, 14-inch and 16-inch, which may retain the MacBook Pro name or adopt the rumored MacBook Ultra. They are expected to launch in October or November, featuring touchscreens, dual-layer OLED, a thinner body, and Dynamic Island. The chips will still be M5 Pro and M5 Max. Mark Gurman states that the new devices will be "significantly lighter." 目前消息指向 14 英寸和 16 英寸两款机型，可能沿用 MacBook Pro 之名，也可能采用传闻中的 MacBook Ultra，预计 10 月或 11 月推出，将配备触控屏、双层 OLED、更薄的机身和灵动岛，芯片仍为 M5 Pro 和 M5 Max。Mark Gurman 称，新机会「明显更轻」。

The iPad mini 8 is expected to be released in October, likely featuring an OLED panel and narrower bezels, powered by an A20 Pro chip, with RAM increased from 8 GB to 12 GB. The front camera position will also be adjusted. iPad mini 8 预计 10 月发布，有望采用 OLED 面板和更窄的边框，搭载 A20 Pro 芯片，内存从 8 GB 增至 12 GB，前置摄像头位置也将调整。

🔗 Related reading: A wave of new Apple products is coming, with a lineup as grand as an iPhone launch event 🔗 相关阅读： 苹果一大波新品要来了，阵仗不输 iPhone 发布会

item.title: OpenAI 向 Chat 用户推送 GPT-6，并加入可交互界面
item.guid: OpenAI-向-Chat-用户推送-GPT-6，并加入可交互界面
item.description:
OpenAI announced on October 7 that GPT-6 is being rolled out to ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise users, with Free and Go users gradually receiving updates starting today. OpenAI 10 月 7 日宣布，GPT-6 开始向 ChatGPT Plus、Pro、Business 和 Enterprise 用户推送，Free 与 Go 用户将在今天起陆续获得更新。

GPT-6 introduces "Intelligent UI" to ChatGPT, allowing responses to combine graphics, buttons, forms, charts, and interactive experiences, and can also directly generate small applications like calculators and bill-splitting tools. GPT-6 在 ChatGPT 中加入「Intelligent UI」，回答可以组合图形、按钮、表单、图表和可交互体验，也能直接生成计算器、分账工具等小型应用。

OpenAI states that GPT-6 can gradually begin answering while still thinking; in internal evaluations, GPT-6 Instant started answering questions requiring web search an average of 44% faster than GPT-5.6 Instant. The ChatGPT version is powered by GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna, while the models used by Work and Codex remain unchanged for now. OpenAI 表示，GPT-6 能在继续思考时逐步开始回答；在内部评测中，GPT-6 Instant 平均比 GPT-5.6 Instant 提前 44% 开始回答需要联网搜索的问题。ChatGPT 版本由 GPT-6 Sol 和 GPT-6 Luna 驱动，Work 与 Codex 使用的模型暂不变化。

item.title: 曝 DeepSeek 即将完成至少 800 亿元融资
item.guid: 曝-DeepSeek-即将完成至少-800-亿元融资
item.description:
According to Bloomberg, citing informed sources on October 6, DeepSeek is about to complete a funding round of at least 80 billion yuan, with Tencent and CATL being among the largest investors. Reuters subsequently reported this news. 据彭博社 10 月 6 日援引知情人士报道，DeepSeek 即将完成一轮至少 800 亿元人民币的融资，腾讯和宁德时代是其中最大的投资方之一。路透社随后转述了这项消息。

This funding round initially aimed to raise approximately 50 billion yuan; based on currently signed investment terms, the final scale could approach 100 billion yuan. Zhidx.com, citing Bloomberg, stated that this funding round might pave the way for an IPO in early 2027, but the transaction terms and listing arrangements have not yet been finalized. The three sets of figures correspond to the current estimated scale, initial target, and potential final scale, respectively, and the financing has not yet been officially announced as complete. 这轮融资最初计划筹集约 500 亿元人民币；按目前签署的投资条款计算，最终规模可能接近 1000 亿元人民币。智东西援引彭博社称，这轮融资可能为 2027 年初的 IPO 铺路，但交易条款和上市安排都还没有最终确定。三组数字分别对应当前预计规模、最初目标与潜在最终规模，融资尚未正式宣布完成。

Reuters reported that DeepSeek, Tencent, and CATL did not immediately respond to requests for comment. DeepSeek had previously collaborated with Huawei to develop programming tools adapted for Ascend chips and launched the V4.1 Flash model in September. 路透社称，DeepSeek、腾讯和宁德时代均未立即回应置评请求。DeepSeek 此前已与华为合作开发适配昇腾芯片的编程工具，并在 9 月推出 V4.1 Flash 模型。

item.title: Anthropic 发布 Claude Haiku 5.5，API 价格最高降低 90%
item.guid: Anthropic-发布-Claude-Haiku-5.5，API-价格最高降低-90%
item.description:
Anthropic released Claude Haiku 5.5 on October 7th, positioning it as a small model for high-concurrency, cost-sensitive tasks, suitable for summarization, compression, database queries, classification, customer service, and browser operations. The official statement claims that Haiku 5.5's operating cost is on average about 75% lower than Haiku 4.5, and its price is 90% lower when processing requests under 100,000 tokens. Anthropic 10 月 7 日发布 Claude Haiku 5.5，定位是面向高并发、成本敏感任务的小模型，适用于摘要、压缩、数据库查询、分类、客服和浏览器操作。官方称，Haiku 5.5 的运行成本平均比 Haiku 4.5 低约 75%，处理 10 万 tokens 以内请求时价格低 90%。

Per million tokens, Haiku 5.5's input price is $0.10 and output price is $0.50; cache reads and writes are $0.01 and $0.125 respectively. The model also offers adjustable effort settings for the first time and has been launched on Claude Platform, Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. 按每百万 tokens 计，Haiku 5.5 的输入价格为 0.10 美元，输出价格为 0.50 美元；缓存读取和写入分别为 0.01 美元和 0.125 美元。模型还首次提供可调节 effort 设置，并已在 Claude Platform、Amazon Web Services、Google Cloud 和 Microsoft Azure 上线。

Anthropic also reduced the cache read price for Claude Sonnet 5.5 from $0.20 to $0.10 per million tokens, stating that the cost of most Agent tasks can decrease by about 20%. Claude Max 5x, Max 20x, and Team users will also receive monthly API credits of $100, $200, and up to $500 respectively this week. Anthropic 同时把 Claude Sonnet 5.5 的缓存读取价格从每百万 tokens 0.20 美元降至 0.10 美元，称多数 Agent 任务成本可下降约 20%。Claude Max 5x、Max 20x 和 Team 用户本周还将分别获得每月 100 美元、200 美元和最高 500 美元的 API 额度。

item.title: 月之暗面估值据报升至约 500 亿美元，筹备明年赴港上市
item.guid: 月之暗面估值据报升至约-500-亿美元，筹备明年赴港上市
item.description:
Bloomberg reported on October 6th, citing informed sources, that Kimi developer Moonshot AI has completed its final pre-IPO private financing round, reaching a valuation of approximately $50 billion. 彭博社 10 月 6 日援引知情人士称，Kimi 开发商月之暗面已完成上市前最后一轮私募融资，估值达到约 500 亿美元。

The company is striving for a listing in Hong Kong in the first quarter of 2027 and plans to hold initial meetings with potential investors as early as this month to gauge market interest in the IPO. 公司正争取在 2027 年第一季度于香港上市，并计划最早在本月与潜在投资者举行初步会面，了解市场对上市的兴趣。

item.title: Nano Banana 2.1 上线，改进文字生成与多图编辑
item.guid: Nano-Banana-2.1-上线，改进文字生成与多图编辑
item.description:
Google's image generation and conversational editing model Nano Banana 2.1 now offers a stable API, with the model identifier gemini-nano-banana-2.1. It is an updated version of Nano Banana 2, with improvements in visual quality, prompt adherence, and character consistency in continuous multi-turn editing. Google 的图像生成与对话式编辑模型 Nano Banana 2.1 已提供稳定版 API，模型标识为 gemini-nano-banana-2.1。它是 Nano Banana 2 的更新版本，改进了视觉质量、提示词遵循和连续多轮编辑中的人物一致性。

The new version supports 1K, 2K, and 4K image output, with a default resolution of 1K. Google states that it has improved text rendering and infographic layout, and fixed stitching artifacts in 2K, 4K ultrawide, or panoramic images. 新版支持 1K、2K 和 4K 图像输出，默认分辨率为 1K。Google 表示，它改进了文字渲染和信息图布局，并修复了 2K、4K 超宽或全景图中的拼接瑕疵。

Editing tasks can reference up to 14 images, supporting consistency for up to 4 characters and 10 objects. Developers can also combine Google Web and Image Search to generate images and choose minimum, medium, or high-intensity thinking settings. 编辑任务最多可参考 14 张图片，其中支持保持最多 4 个角色和 10 个物体的一致性。开发者还可结合 Google 网页与图片搜索生成图像，并选择最小、中等或高强度的思考设置。

item.title: 2026 年诺贝尔奖陆续公布，目前已有 6 位得主
item.guid: 2026-年诺贝尔奖陆续公布，目前已有-6-位得主
item.description:
As of yesterday, the 2026 Nobel Prizes in Physiology or Medicine, Physics, and Chemistry have been announced, with a total of 6 scientists awarded; the prizes for Literature, Peace, and Economic Sciences will be announced in the coming days. 截至昨日，2026 年诺贝尔奖已公布生理学或医学奖、物理学奖和化学奖，共有 6 位科学家获奖；文学奖、和平奖和经济学奖将在接下来几天陆续公布。

This year's Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine was awarded to Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann, and Georg Nagel, in recognition of their "discoveries concerning light-gated ion channels and optogenetics." Their research has advanced optogenetics, enabling researchers to precisely control specific neural cell activity using light, and thereby study the neural circuits underlying memory, emotion, and behavior. 今年 诺贝尔生理学或医学奖 授予 Karl Deisseroth、Peter Hegemann 和 Georg Nagel，以表彰他们「在光门控离子通道和光遗传学方面的发现」。三人的研究推动了光遗传学的发展，使研究人员能够利用光精确控制特定神经细胞活动，并借此研究记忆、情绪和行为背后的神经回路。

The Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded solely to Francis Halzen for his "decisive contributions to the IceCube Neutrino Observatory and the discovery of high-energy neutrinos of astrophysical origin." Halzen spearheaded the use of Antarctic ice to detect neutrinos, ultimately leading to the construction of the IceCube Neutrino Observatory, a cubic kilometer in volume and equipped with 5160 optical sensors, which opened a new observational window for high-energy neutrino astronomy. 诺贝尔物理学奖 由 Francis Halzen 一人获得，获奖理由为「对冰立方中微子天文台作出的决定性贡献，以及发现具有天体物理起源的高能中微子」。Halzen 推动利用南极冰层探测中微子，最终建成体积约 1 立方千米、布置有 5160 个光学传感器的 IceCube 中微子天文台，为高能中微子天文学开辟了新的观测窗口。

Yesterday's announced Nobel Prize in Chemistry was awarded to Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai, in recognition of their "discovery of nonlinear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis." 昨日公布的 诺贝尔化学奖 授予 Henri B. Kagan 和 Kenso Soai，以表彰二人「发现不对称有机合成中的非线性效应和自催化现象」。

The related research explains how chemical reactions produce and continuously amplify specific molecular "chirality," helping to understand the formation of homochirality in life and having a significant impact on the design of asymmetric reactions in drug synthesis. The two will share the 12 million Swedish Kronor prize money. 相关研究解释了化学反应如何产生并不断放大特定的分子「手性」，有助于理解生命中同手性现象的形成，并对药物合成中的不对称反应设计产生重要影响。两人将平分 1200 万瑞典克朗奖金。

According to the official Nobel Prize schedule, the Literature Prize will be announced today, and the Peace Prize and Economic Sciences Prize will be announced on October 9th and October 12th, respectively. 按照诺贝尔奖官方日程，文学奖将于今日公布，和平奖和经济学奖分别将在 10 月 9 日和 10 月 12 日公布。

🔗 Related Reading: 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics Announced: He Used Antarctic Ice to Observe the Universe 🔗 相关阅读： 2026 诺贝尔物理学奖揭晓，他用南极冰层观测宇宙

item.title: 华为徐直军：昇腾在中国可统计市场的份额已超过英伟达
item.guid: 华为徐直军：昇腾在中国可统计市场的份额已超过英伟达
item.description:
In the recently released media communication minutes from Huawei Connect, Rotating Chairman Xu Zhijun stated that it is difficult to quantify Nvidia's market share in China, but based on data Huawei can track, Ascend's market share should have already surpassed Nvidia's. 在近日公布的华为全联接大会媒体交流纪要中，轮值董事长徐直军表示，中国市场的英伟达份额很难统计，但按华为能够统计到的数据看，昇腾的市场份额应该已经超过英伟达。

Xu Zhijun said that the current supply of Ascend is still insufficient to meet the demand of the Chinese market, and Huawei has no plans for comprehensive overseas market expansion. Domestic customers will receive priority supply; overseas business primarily targets a few customers who have genuine needs, find it difficult to obtain computing power, or require an alternative. 徐直军称，当前昇腾供给仍不足以满足中国市场需求，华为没有全面拓展海外市场的计划，国内客户将获得优先供应；海外业务主要面向少数确有需求、难以取得算力或需要另一种选择的客户。

The supernode based on 950DT is still in the testing phase, with mass supply expected to begin by the end of this year or early next year. He anticipates that a large number of model trainings will be built on this system starting next year. 基于 950DT 的超节点仍处于测试阶段，预计今年年底或明年初开始规模供货。他预计，从明年起会有大量模型训练建立在这一系统上。

Regarding chip supply bottlenecks, Xu Zhijun believes that optical modules, storage, and other components are not ready for the rapid growth of AI demand, and global supply-demand balance may not be achieved until 2029, possibly later in China. Huawei's single-chip solutions are still limited by domestic manufacturing processes, while multi-chip interconnects and system architecture are its key investment directions. 谈到芯片供应瓶颈，徐直军认为，光模块、存储等环节都没有为 AI 需求的快速增长做好准备，全球供需平衡可能到 2029 年才能实现，中国可能更晚。华为单芯片仍受国内工艺限制，多芯片互联和系统架构则是其重点投入的路线。

In another media roundtable announced by Huawei on October 5, Richard Yu stated that the total number of HarmonyOS 6 and HarmonyOS 7 devices has exceeded 90 million units, and is expected to exceed 100 million units by the end of the year; Huawei already has preliminary plans to promote HarmonyOS overseas, which will be advanced in steps. 华为 10 月 5 日公布的另一场媒体圆桌中，余承东表示，鸿蒙 6、鸿蒙 7 的设备总数已超过 9000 万台，预计年底超过 1 亿台；华为已有将鸿蒙推向海外的初步计划，将分步骤推进。

Richard Yu said that since 2019, Huawei has continuously restructured its supply chain and resumed domestic manufacturing of mobile phone chips in 2023. According to him, Huawei has basically gotten rid of its reliance on US technology at the chip and operating system levels, but the production capacity for advanced domestic processes remains tight. 余承东称，自 2019 年以来，华为持续重构供应链，并在 2023 年恢复手机芯片的国内制造。按照他的说法，华为在芯片和操作系统层面已基本摆脱对美国技术的依赖，国产先进制程的产能仍然紧张。

item.title: 高通澄清华为专利协议：不涉及逻辑折叠，也非净支付方
item.guid: 高通澄清华为专利协议：不涉及逻辑折叠，也非净支付方
item.description:
On October 6, Qualcomm responded to Yicai, stating that reports of it being a 'net payer' in the Huawei patent licensing agreement were inaccurate, and claims that the agreement involved logic folding chip technology were also untrue. Qualcomm also confirmed that it has agreed to purchase some of Huawei's non-cellular communication US patents in multiple technology areas. 10 月 6 日，高通向第一财经回应称，外界关于其在华为专利许可协议中属于「净支付方」的消息不准确，协议涉及逻辑折叠芯片技术的说法也不属实。高通同时确认，已同意购买华为在多个技术领域的部分非蜂窝通信美国专利。

The multi-year patent licensing agreement announced by both parties on October 5 covers cross-licensing of patent portfolios in areas such as 5G, computing, AI, and networking, and includes the transfer of some US patents. Qualcomm's latest response distinguished between the publicly disclosed scope of the agreement and the specific technologies and payment directions circulating in the market; the commercial terms of the agreement remain confidential. 双方于 10 月 5 日公布的是一项多年期专利许可协议，涵盖 5G、计算、AI 和网络等领域的专利组合交叉许可，并包含部分美国专利的转让。高通的最新回应区分了协议已公开的授权范围与市场流传的具体技术、支付方向，协议商业条款仍属保密内容。

Yicai reported that the relevant transaction still requires necessary regulatory approvals. John Han, head of Qualcomm's technology licensing business, stated that the agreement reflects both parties' recognition of each other's intellectual property in 5G and other fields; Fan Zhiyong, Huawei's Chief Intellectual Property Officer, stated that the agreement demonstrates the value of Huawei's innovation. 第一财经称，相关交易还需获得必要的监管批准。高通技术许可业务负责人 John Han 表示，协议体现了双方对彼此在 5G 及其他领域知识产权的认可；华为首席知识产权官樊志勇则表示，协议展示了华为创新的价值。

item.title: 蔚来单日换电达 18.37 万单，再创纪录
item.guid: 蔚来单日换电达-18.37-万单，再创纪录
item.description:
According to IT Home, Nio announced on October 6 that its single-day battery swap volume on October 5 reached 183,664 orders, surpassing the record of 183,469 orders set on October 1. This total covers three brands: Nio, Onvo, and Firefly. Calculated over the entire day, an average of approximately one battery swap was completed every 0.47 seconds. 据 IT 之家报道，蔚来 10 月 6 日公布，10 月 5 日单日换电量达到 183,664 单，超过 10 月 1 日创下的 183,469 单纪录。这一总量覆盖蔚来、乐道与萤火虫三个品牌，按全天统计，平均约每 0.47 秒完成一单换电。

During the return journey, the single-station battery swap volume at highway stations also increased. The Rizhao Service Area Haikou direction station on the Shenhai Expressway in Rizhao, Shandong, completed 188 orders; the Dahai Service Area Shenyang direction station in Jiangmen, Guangdong, completed 176 orders; and two highway stations in Jiangdu and Hongze Lake, Jiangsu, tied for third with 171 orders each. 返程期间，高速站的单站换电量也上升。山东日照沈海高速日照服务区海口方向站完成 188 单，广东江门大槐服务区沈阳方向站完成 176 单；江苏江都与洪泽湖的两座高速站以 171 单并列第三。

As of this announcement, Nio has built 4,165 battery swap stations nationwide, providing over 127 million battery swap services in total. Among these, 1,073 are highway battery swap stations, forming a '9 vertical, 11 horizontal, 16 major city clusters' network, connecting over 550 cities. 截至此次公布，蔚来在全国已建成 4,165 座换电站，累计提供超过 1.27 亿次换电服务。其中，高速公路换电站为 1,073 座，形成「9 纵 11 横 16 大城市群」网络，连通超过 550 个城市。

item.title: 全球纯汽油车份额首次跌破 50%
item.guid: 全球纯汽油车份额首次跌破-50%
item.description:
According to Mobility Global data disclosed by Nikkei Asia in early October, pure gasoline vehicles accounted for 49% of global new car sales in the first half of this year, falling below half for the first time. Sales of these models were 20.25 million units, a year-on-year decrease of 10%; their market share dropped by 3 percentage points compared to the same period last year, while in 2021, this proportion was still 73%. 据日经亚洲 10 月初披露的 Mobility Global 数据，今年上半年，纯汽油车占全球新车销量的比例降至 49%，首次跌破一半。相关车型销量为 2025 万辆，同比下降 10%；市场份额比去年同期下降 3 个百分点，2021 年这一比例仍为 73%。

This statistic does not include hybrid and other electrified models, and also excludes some heavy vehicles. Pure electric vehicles sold 6.87 million units in the first half of the year, a year-on-year increase of 12%, accounting for 17% of global new car sales; hybrid vehicles sold 7.27 million units, a year-on-year increase of 10%, accounting for 18%. 这项统计不包含混合动力及其他电气化车型，也排除了部分重型车辆。纯电动车上半年售出 687 万辆，同比增长 12%，占全球新车销量的 17%；混动车售出 727 万辆，同比增长 10%，占比 18%。

Nikkei linked the changes to rising oil prices after the Middle East conflict and consumers seeking models with lower operating costs. Sales of pure gasoline vehicles decreased by 26% in China and 13% in Europe. The growth of pure electric vehicles mainly came from Europe, Southeast Asia, and Oceania, with sales increasing by 32% in Europe and 81% in Southeast Asia. 日经将变化与中东冲突后油价走高、消费者寻找更低使用成本的车型联系起来。纯汽油车销量在中国下降 26%，欧洲下降 13%。纯电动车的增长主要来自欧洲、东南亚和大洋洲，其中欧洲销量增长 32%，东南亚增长 81%。

China still contributes about half of global pure electric vehicle sales, but sales in the first half of this year decreased by 3% year-on-year; North America saw a 15% decrease, with both regions affected by adjustments in incentive policies. 中国仍贡献约一半的全球纯电动车销量，但今年上半年销量同比下降 3%；北美下降 15%，两地均受到激励政策调整影响。

item.title: 韩国计划投入 4.7 万亿韩元开发前沿 AI 模型
item.guid: 韩国计划投入-4.7-万亿韩元开发前沿-AI-模型
item.description:
According to Reuters, South Korea's Ministry of Science and ICT announced on October 6 that it plans to launch a frontier AI model project starting in March 2027, with a total investment of 4.7 trillion Korean won, or approximately 3.5 billion US dollars. 据路透社报道，韩国科学技术信息通信部 10 月 6 日宣布，计划从 2027 年 3 月启动前沿 AI 模型项目，总投入为 4.7 万亿韩元，约合 35 亿美元。

The project will combine government equity investment with private capital, focusing on chip, data, and talent resources. Companies can participate individually or form consortia or special purpose companies with startups, universities, and research institutions to bid. 项目将结合政府股权投资与民间资金，集中芯片、数据和人才资源。企业可单独参与，也可与初创公司、大学和研究机构组建联合体或特殊目的公司竞标。

This plan still requires parliamentary approval of next year's budget in December. After the budget is passed, the government will launch a tender for leading agencies, with teams selected as early as February next year. Another ongoing local foundational model project will continue to advance, expected to enter its third phase in February next year, selecting the final two teams. 这项计划仍需国会在 12 月批准明年的预算。预算通过后，政府将启动牵头机构招标，最快于明年 2 月选定团队。另一个正在进行的本土基础模型项目会继续推进，预计于明年 2 月进入第三阶段，选出最终两支团队。

item.title: Google 签下约 3.6 吉瓦电力协议，核电增容占约四分之一
item.guid: Google-签下约-3.6-吉瓦电力协议，核电增容占约四分之一
item.description:
Google and US energy company Constellation Energy announced a long-term power agreement, with a total procurement scale of 3590 megawatts, or approximately 3.6 gigawatts. New nuclear power will account for about a quarter of this, and the electricity will be connected to PJM, the largest power grid in the United States. Google 与美国能源公司 Constellation Energy 宣布达成长期电力协议，采购规模合计 3590 兆瓦，约合 3.6 吉瓦。新增核电约占其中四分之一，电力将接入美国最大的电网 PJM。

Among these, Google signed a 20-year nuclear power purchase agreement for 890 megawatts. Constellation will upgrade existing reactors to increase power generation, involving 11 nuclear units in Illinois, Pennsylvania, and New Jersey, with the first batch of increased capacity power expected to be delivered in 2028. 其中，Google 签订了一份为期 20 年、规模为 890 兆瓦的核电采购协议。Constellation 将升级现有反应堆以增加发电量，涉及伊利诺伊州、宾夕法尼亚州和新泽西州的 11 台核电机组，首批增容电力预计于 2028 年交付。

The remaining 2700 megawatts come from Constellation's long-term power supply arrangements, not tied to specific generation methods. The two companies stated that this collaboration will drive over $4.3 billion in new investments for Constellation. 另外 2700 兆瓦来自 Constellation 的长期供电安排，不绑定特定发电方式。两家公司表示，此次合作将带动 Constellation 超过 43 亿美元的新投资。

PJM previously proposed that data centers connected to the grid should have their own power supply, otherwise they might be remotely disconnected during peak demand. The two companies stated that this agreement is a response to that proposal. PJM 此前提出，接入电网的数据中心应自带电源，否则在用电高峰时可能被远程断供。两家公司称，本次协议正是对这一提议的回应。

item.title: Suno 在意大利被调查，单方改价和版权条款受质疑
item.guid: Suno-在意大利被调查，单方改价和版权条款受质疑
item.description:
Italy's competition regulator AGCM announced on October 6 that it has launched an investigation into AI music generation company Suno, examining whether its terms of service are unfair to consumers. The regulator believes that the relevant terms may cause a significant imbalance between user rights and obligations. 意大利竞争监管机构 AGCM 于 10 月 6 日宣布，对 AI 音乐生成公司 Suno 启动调查，审查其服务条款是否对消费者不公平。监管机构认为，相关条款可能造成用户权利与义务的显著失衡。

The investigation concerns Suno's power to unilaterally modify contracts, services, and subscription prices: the company can make adjustments without providing a valid reason. Another focus is the copyright license granted by users to the platform, which regulators believe is too broad, and the arrangement requiring users to waive moral rights may also violate Italian copyright law. 调查涉及 Suno 单方面修改合同、服务和订阅价格的权力：公司可在无需说明正当理由的情况下作出调整。另一项焦点是用户授予平台的版权许可，监管机构认为其范围过于宽泛，要求用户放弃著作人格权的安排也可能违反意大利版权法。

Suno's terms also require users to accept mandatory arbitration in the United States, waive class action lawsuits, and designate Massachusetts as the exclusive jurisdiction, arrangements that are also under review. Suno 的条款还要求用户在美国接受强制仲裁、放弃集体诉讼，并将马萨诸塞州设为专属管辖地，这些安排同样进入审查范围。

The AGCM will launch a public consultation in the coming weeks, allowing industry organizations, chambers of commerce, and consumer associations to participate. The investigation has not yet reached a final ruling; according to Reuters, Suno has not yet responded to requests for comment. AGCM 将在未来数周展开公开咨询，允许行业组织、商会和消费者协会参与。调查尚未形成最终裁决；据路透社报道，Suno 暂未回应置评请求。

item.title: OpenAI 公开 722 篇数学手稿，部分证明仍待核验
item.guid: OpenAI-公开-722-篇数学手稿，部分证明仍待核验
item.description:
OpenAI has released 722 mathematical manuscripts generated by its internal frontier models and organized the results into a GitHub repository. They are categorized into 372 families of results, where one group might contain a main result, related corollaries, or different proof methods, and should not be simply understood as solving 722 independent problems. OpenAI 公开了由内部前沿模型生成的 722 篇数学手稿，并将成果整理进 GitHub 仓库。它们按 372 个成果家族归类，一组可能包含主结果、相关推论或不同证明方式，不能简单理解为解出了 722 道独立难题。

These manuscripts are at different stages of verification: some are accompanied by Lean formal proofs, while others still rely on informal arguments. OpenAI warns that content not yet formalized may contain errors and will continue to check and revise them. 这些手稿处于不同核验阶段：部分配有 Lean 形式化证明，部分仍依赖非形式化论证。OpenAI 提醒，尚未形式化的内容可能存在错误，将继续检查并修订。

WIRED previously reported that the announcement plan sparked skepticism from some mathematicians, with disputes involving review, citation, and publication processes. OpenAI stated that after communicating with an independent research team at the Institute for Advanced Study in Princeton, it adjusted the disclosure method, citation norms, and subsequent discussion arrangements. The models that generated these studies have not yet been released. WIRED 此前报道，公布计划引发部分数学家的质疑，争议涉及评审、引用和发表流程。OpenAI 表示，在与普林斯顿高等研究院一个独立研究团队沟通后，调整了公开方式、引用规范及后续讨论安排。生成这些研究的模型尚未发布。

item.title: 曝可灵 AI 选定上市银行，香港 IPO 拟募资至少 10 亿美元
item.guid: 曝可灵-AI-选定上市银行，香港-IPO-拟募资至少-10-亿美元
item.description:
Kuaishou's video generation business, Keling AI, has selected CICC, Goldman Sachs, and UBS to prepare for a Hong Kong listing, planning to raise at least $1 billion, Bloomberg reported, citing sources. 据彭博社援引知情人士报道，快手旗下的视频生成业务可灵 AI 已选定中金公司、高盛和瑞银，筹备在香港上市，计划募资至少 10 亿美元。

The listing could take place as early as next year. Sources said discussions are ongoing, and the fundraising size and timing may be adjusted; Goldman Sachs and UBS declined to comment, and Keling AI and CICC did not respond to requests for comment. 上市最早可能在明年进行。知情人士称，讨论仍在推进，募资规模和时间都可能调整；高盛和瑞银拒绝置评，可灵 AI 与中金公司未回应置评请求。

Keling AI was launched in 2024, offering tools to generate videos from text or images. This preparation is for the listing of this AI video business, and the report has not yet provided a confirmed issuance timetable. 可灵 AI 于 2024 年推出，提供通过文字或图片生成视频的工具。此次筹备的是这一 AI 视频业务的上市，报道尚未给出已经确定的发行时间表。

item.title: SpaceX 据报洽谈 400 亿美元融资，用于采购英伟达芯片
item.guid: SpaceX-据报洽谈-400-亿美元融资，用于采购英伟达芯片
item.description:
SpaceX is in early discussions with banks and investment firms to raise $40 billion to purchase Nvidia chips, Bloomberg reported on October 7, citing sources. 彭博社 10 月 7 日援引知情人士报道，SpaceX 正与银行及投资机构进行早期磋商，计划筹集 400 亿美元，用于购买英伟达芯片。

Pacific Investment Management Company (PIMCO) is one of the investment firms interested in participating. The report states that if this debt financing plan proceeds, it would be a large-scale borrowing transaction centered on AI development; negotiations are still in early stages and may ultimately not reach an agreement. 太平洋投资管理公司 PIMCO 是有意参与的投资机构之一。报道说，如果这一债务融资方案推进，将成为围绕 AI 建设的大规模借款交易；目前谈判仍处早期，最终也可能无法达成协议。

The Financial Times previously reported on this financing plan. Bloomberg later confirmed the fundraising discussions and PIMCO's interest in participating with sources, and SpaceX did not immediately respond to requests for comment. 《金融时报》此前报道了这一融资计划。彭博社随后从知情人士处确认了筹资讨论与 PIMCO 的参与意向，SpaceX 未立即回应置评请求。

item.title: 波士顿动力任命前亚马逊 AI 负责人为 CEO，推动机器人商业化
item.guid: 波士顿动力任命前亚马逊-AI-负责人为-CEO，推动机器人商业化
item.description:
Boston Dynamics announced that Rohit Prasad will assume the role of CEO, effective October 7. He was previously the Senior Vice President and Chief Scientist for Amazon's Alexa and General AI business. 波士顿动力宣布，Rohit Prasad 将出任 CEO，任命自 10 月 7 日起生效。他此前是亚马逊 Alexa 与通用人工智能业务的高级副总裁兼首席科学家。

Prasad worked at Amazon for 12 years, participating in the early development of Alexa and leading the development of the Amazon Nova family of foundational models. Before joining Amazon, he spent nearly 14 years working on machine learning research and applications at Raytheon BBN Technologies. Prasad 在亚马逊工作了 12 年，参与从早期构建 Alexa，并主导了 Amazon Nova 基础模型家族的开发。加入亚马逊前，他曾在 Raytheon BBN Technologies 从事近 14 年机器学习研究及应用工作。

Boston Dynamics stated that the new CEO will drive the integration of AI and robotics and scale the deployment of intelligent machines. The company's current products include the quadruped robot Spot for industrial inspection, Stretch for logistics box handling, and the electric humanoid robot Atlas, which is still under development. Prasad is also expected to join the board of directors, subject to completing relevant approval procedures. 波士顿动力表示，新任 CEO 将推动 AI 与机器人结合，并将智能机器规模化落地。公司目前的产品包括用于工业巡检的四足机器人 Spot、面向物流搬箱的 Stretch，以及仍处开发阶段的电动人形机器人 Atlas。Prasad 还预计加入董事会，但须完成相关批准程序。

item.title: 💡 加菲尔德谈饰演 Sam Altman：应看清我们交出权力的对象
item.guid: 💡-加菲尔德谈饰演-Sam-Altman：应看清我们交出权力的对象
item.description:
During a live dialogue at the New York Film Festival premiere of the film 'Artificial,' Andrew Garfield, who plays Sam Altman, spoke about how he initially found Altman to be candid and transparent when watching his 2023 testimony before the U.S. Congress: he proactively discussed regulation and emphasized that he held no company equity. This impression changed as he conducted further research. 在电影《Artificial》的纽约电影节首映现场对话中，饰演 Sam Altman 的安德鲁·加菲尔德谈到，他最初观看奥特曼 2023 年在美国国会作证的视频时，觉得对方坦诚、透明：主动谈监管，也强调自己没有公司股权。这种印象随着他进一步研究而发生变化。

Garfield spent two to three months watching and listening to relevant materials for the role. He said that during filming, news about AI risks appeared almost daily, and participating in this film brought him a sense of moral responsibility. He hopes the film can present these issues more sharply, illuminating the hidden corners of those to whom the public surrenders autonomy and power. 加菲尔德为角色花了两三个月观看和聆听相关材料。他说，拍摄期间几乎每天都有关于 AI 风险的新闻出现，参与这部电影带给他一种道德责任。他希望电影能更尖锐地呈现这些问题，照亮公众交出自主权与权力的那些人的隐蔽角落。

He has previously played real-life figures in works such as 'The Social Network' and 'Tick, Tick... Boom!'. Discussing this creative responsibility, he emphasized maintaining empathy and imagining that when a person sees themselves on screen, they might feel 'that's not me,' or even find it difficult to face. He explicitly stated that this is merely his own conjecture and projection, and cannot replace Altman's actual reaction. 他此前也在《社交网络》《倒数时刻》等作品中扮演过真实人物。谈到这种创作责任，他强调保持同情心，并想象一个人看到银幕上的自己时，可能会觉得「那不是我」，甚至感到难以面对。他明确说，这只是自己的设想与投射，不能代替奥特曼本人的反应。

'Artificial,' directed by Luca Guadagnino and written by Simon Rich, revolves around Altman's experience of being fired from OpenAI and then returning to the company. Garfield believes the film should make audiences examine these figures who wield immense power more closely. The film will be released in the United States on December 25. 《Artificial》由卢卡·瓜达尼诺执导、Simon Rich 编剧，围绕奥特曼被 OpenAI 解雇又重返公司的经历展开。加菲尔德认为，电影应让观众更仔细地审视这些掌握巨大权力的人物。影片将于 12 月 25 日在美国上映。

item.title: 特斯拉推出万圣节模式，可用车灯和音效迎接访客
item.guid: 特斯拉推出万圣节模式，可用车灯和音效迎接访客
item.description:
Tesla officially announced the rollout of 'Halloween Mode,' allowing the vehicle's screen, lights, and exterior sound effects to participate in the holiday decor. The car's on-screen image will change into a ghost costume, and when the 'Trick-or-Treat' function is enabled, bizarre sound effects and flashing lights can be triggered when visitors approach. 特斯拉官方宣布开始推送「万圣节模式」，让车辆屏幕、灯光与车外音效一起参与节日装扮。车辆在屏幕上的形象会换上幽灵服装，启用「不给糖就捣蛋」功能后，访客靠近时可触发怪诞音效与车灯闪烁。

The update also adds new theme light shows, screen body wraps, and lock sound effects, as well as a Photobooth photo function with spooky effects. Car owners can also speak remotely through the mobile app, and the vehicle will play it back using processed sounds. 更新还加入新的主题灯光秀、屏幕车身装扮和锁车音效，以及带惊悚效果的 Photobooth 拍照功能。车主也可以通过手机 App 远程说话，由车辆用经过处理的声音播放出来。

In the same set of official update posts, Tesla labeled this round of software updates as 2026.38.3. The aforementioned holiday features have entered the rollout phase, and with Halloween still on October 31st, vehicles can adopt the holiday theme in advance. 在同一组官方更新帖中，特斯拉将本轮软件更新标为 2026.38.3。上述节日功能已经进入推送阶段，万圣节仍在 10 月 31 日，车辆可以提前换上节日主题。

item.title: Mistral Large 4 开放 API 预览，模型权重月底发布
item.guid: Mistral-Large-4-开放-API-预览，模型权重月底发布
item.description:
Mistral AI launched a public preview of Mistral Large 4 on October 6th, codenamed 'le Chonk'. Developers can now use the preview API via Mistral Studio, with model weights planned to be released by the end of the month. Mistral AI 于 10 月 6 日推出 Mistral Large 4 的公开预览版，代号「le Chonk」。开发者现在可通过 Mistral Studio 使用预览 API，模型权重计划在月底开放。

This native multimodal model adopts a mixture-of-experts architecture, with a total of approximately 1 trillion parameters, activating 49 billion parameters per inference, and is designed for programming, agent workflows, image understanding, and enterprise tasks. The official statement claims the model was trained from scratch on 3800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs in its own data centers in Europe, with training data covering over 160 languages. 这款原生多模态模型采用混合专家架构，总参数约 1 万亿，每次激活 490 亿参数，面向编程、Agent 工作流、图像理解及企业任务。官方称，模型从头在欧洲自有数据中心的 3800 张 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPU 上训练，训练数据覆盖超过 160 种语言。

Mistral is conducting real-world red team testing with cybersecurity agencies, trusted partners, and government organizations. Testers can access versions with reduced content moderation restrictions and enhanced cybersecurity capabilities. The company plans to further disclose the model architecture, evaluations, and post-training methods when weights are released, and based on this, launch models tailored for different specialized tasks. Mistral 正与网络安全机构、受信任合作伙伴及政府机构展开真实场景红队测试，测试方可访问降低内容审查限制、增强网络安全能力的版本。公司计划在开放权重时进一步公布模型架构、测评及后训练方法，并以此为基础推出面向不同专业任务的模型。

item.title: Hark 推出个人 AI 助手，可连接账户并代办网页任务
item.guid: Hark-推出个人-AI-助手，可连接账户并代办网页任务
item.description:
Hark Pro, the first product from Brett Adcock's Hark Labs, is now available as a web version, iOS, and Android app. It can connect to users' email, calendar, and other services, remember personal preferences, and execute web tasks via cloud computing. Brett Adcock 创办的 Hark Labs 上线了首款产品 Hark Pro，现已开放网页版、iOS 和 Android 应用。它可以连接用户的邮箱、日历及其他服务，记住个人偏好，并通过云端计算机执行网页任务。

Hark's Handoff feature can operate up to 6 browser windows simultaneously. After a user logs into a website, the assistant can continue the task; API-supported services can directly connect to Google, Outlook, or MCP. Projects are used to permanently save chats and files for individual projects, and the Home page can generate small applications connected to personal account data, as well as action buttons for paying bills, canceling subscriptions, and more. Hark 的 Handoff 功能最多可同时操作 6 个浏览器窗口。用户登录网站后，助手可以继续完成任务；支持 API 的服务则可直接连接 Google、Outlook 或 MCP。Projects 用于长期保存单个项目的聊天和文件，Home 页面可生成连接个人账户数据的小应用，以及支付账单、取消订阅等操作按钮。

The company states that passwords and bank card information are stored in an encrypted vault, users can delete their own data, and related information will not be sold to advertisers. These are Hark's announced product and privacy commitments. 公司称，密码和银行卡信息保存在加密保险库中，用户可以删除自己的数据，相关信息不会出售给广告商。这些是 Hark 公布的产品与隐私承诺。

All features offer a free usage quota; Hark Pro² costs $20 per month, with double the quota of the free version, and Hark Pro³ costs $100 per month, offering 10 times the quota. 全部功能提供免费使用额度；Hark Pro² 每月 20 美元，额度为免费版的 2 倍，Hark Pro³ 每月 100 美元，提供 10 倍额度。

item.title: 微软发布 Surface Laptop Ultra，并推出 RTX Spark 本地 AI 设备
item.guid: 微软发布-Surface-Laptop-Ultra，并推出-RTX-Spark-本地-AI-设备
item.description:
Microsoft and NVIDIA unveiled the Surface Laptop Ultra, Surface RTX Spark Dev Box, and local AI capabilities for Windows at an event in San Francisco. 微软与英伟达在旧金山活动上公布 Surface Laptop Ultra、Surface RTX Spark Dev Box，以及面向 Windows 的本地 AI 能力。

The Surface Laptop Ultra is equipped with NVIDIA RTX Spark chips, and Microsoft states its goal is to enable AI Agent tasks such as coding and complex business projects to run directly on the computer locally. Surface Laptop Ultra 搭载英伟达 RTX Spark 芯片，微软称其目标是让写代码、复杂业务项目等 AI Agent 任务直接在电脑本地运行。

Currently, the Surface Laptop Ultra is available for pre-order, starting at $2599, with shipments beginning October 16th; the Surface RTX Spark Dev Box starts at $3999. 目前，Surface Laptop Ultra 已开启预订，起售价 2599 美元，10 月 16 日开始供货；Surface RTX Spark Dev Box 起售价 3999 美元。

item.title: 苹果：2025 年中国 App Store 生态系统促成约 4 万亿元交易
item.guid: 苹果：2025-年中国-App-Store-生态系统促成约-4-万亿元交易
item.description:
Apple today released a research report showing that the total turnover and sales generated by China's App Store ecosystem in 2025 will be approximately 4 trillion RMB, nearly doubling from 2020. Apple 今天发布研报显示，2025 年中国 App Store 生态系统促成的营业额与销售额合计约 4 万亿元人民币，较 2020 年接近翻倍。

The report estimates that in 2025, apps from Chinese developers will account for 93% of App Store downloads and 98% of revenue in China; Chinese developers' apps have been downloaded over 10 billion times globally, with revenue from overseas users rising to 52%. 报告估算，2025 年中国开发者的 app 占中国 App Store 下载量的 93%、收入的 98%；中国开发者在全球 App Store 的下载量超过 100 亿次，来自海外用户的收入占比升至 52%。

Over 95% of turnover and sales do not require commission payments to Apple, primarily coming from sales of physical goods and services, digital goods and services, and in-app advertising. 超过 95% 的营业额和销售额无需向 Apple 支付佣金，主要来自实体商品和服务销售、数字商品与服务以及 app 内广告。

The report also mentioned that Apple will adjust the standard commission rate for China to 25% and the preferential commission rate to 12% in March 2026; in 2025, Apple's developer relations team engaged with over 2000 development teams and more than 18,000 Chinese developers. 报告还提到，Apple 在 2026 年 3 月将中国区标准佣金率调整为 25%，优惠佣金率调整为 12%；2025 年 Apple 开发者关系团队与超过 2000 个开发团队、1.8 万多名中国开发者开展了交流。

item.title: 第三家小猪佩奇主题咖啡馆将于本月在苏州开业
item.guid: 第三家小猪佩奇主题咖啡馆将于本月在苏州开业
item.description:
According to Variety, Hasbro will open its third Peppa Pig Play Café in China in Suzhou in October, extending Peppa Pig's animated scenes into themed dining, interactive play, and character meet-and-greet activities, targeting preschoolers and their families. 据 Variety 报道，孩之宝将在 10 月于苏州开设中国第三家 Peppa Pig Play Café，将小猪佩奇的动画场景延伸到主题餐饮、互动游玩和角色见面活动中，面向学龄前儿童及其家庭。

Matt Proulx, Hasbro's executive in charge of global experiences, stated that the first two stores helped the team adjust the menu to match the dining quality with the play experience. Parents can reserve tables, children can participate in live interactions, and meals are an important part of this experience. 孩之宝负责全球体验业务的高管 Matt Proulx 表示，前两家店帮助团队调整了菜单，让餐饮质量与游玩体验相匹配。家长可预约餐桌，孩子则能参与现场互动，餐食也是这一体验的重要部分。

Hasbro also announced the name of its new Brazilian project, Transformers Mission Energon Gramado. This permanent immersive facility, built with local partners, is planned to open in Rio Grande do Sul by the end of 2026. 孩之宝同时公布了巴西新项目 Transformers Mission Energon Gramado 的名称。这一与当地合作方打造的固定沉浸式设施，计划在 2026 年年底前于南里奥格兰德州开业。

item.title: 梅赛德斯-奔驰第三季度销量下降 8%，电动车销量增长 52%
item.guid: 梅赛德斯-奔驰第三季度销量下降-8%，电动车销量增长-52%
item.description:
In Mercedes-Benz's released third-quarter data, core passenger car sales decreased by 8% year-on-year to 407,200 units, mainly affected by weak demand in the Chinese market; meanwhile, pure electric vehicle sales increased by 52%. The company stated that intensified competition in the Chinese market and declining demand for internal combustion engine vehicles continue to impact overall performance. 梅赛德斯-奔驰公布的第三季度数据中，核心乘用车业务销量同比下降 8% 至 40.72 万辆，主要受到中国市场需求疲软影响；同期纯电动车销量增长 52%。公司称，中国市场竞争加剧和燃油车需求下滑仍在影响整体表现。

This data appears concurrently with its pressures in the Chinese market: demand for traditional luxury cars continues to shrink, and the increase in electric vehicles has not yet fully offset the decline in fuel vehicle business. 这组数据与其在中国市场的压力同时出现：传统豪华车需求继续收缩，电动车增量尚未完全抵消燃油车业务的下滑。

item.title: 派拉蒙完成收购华纳兄弟探索，新公司定名 Skydance
item.guid: 派拉蒙完成收购华纳兄弟探索，新公司定名-Skydance
item.description:
On October 6, Paramount announced the completion of its acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, with the merged company named Skydance. The transaction has received the necessary regulatory approvals, and the new company trades on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol SKYD, while Warner Bros. Discovery shares ceased trading on Nasdaq on the same day. 10 月 6 日，派拉蒙宣布完成对华纳兄弟探索的收购，合并后的公司定名为 Skydance。交易已取得所需监管批准，新公司以股票代码 SKYD 在纽约证券交易所交易，华纳兄弟探索股票同日停止在纳斯达克交易。

The new company brings together two major film studios, Paramount and Warner Bros., as well as HBO, CBS, CNN, and sports content assets. IPs such as 'Top Gun,' 'Harry Potter,' 'The White Lotus,' and 'SpongeBob SquarePants' are now part of the same group, with its streaming platforms having a combined total of over 200 million subscriptions. 新公司旗下集合了派拉蒙、华纳兄弟两大电影制片厂，以及 HBO、CBS、CNN 和体育内容资产。《壮志凌云》《哈利·波特》《白莲花度假村》和《海绵宝宝》等 IP 归入同一集团，旗下流媒体平台订阅合计超过 2 亿。

Skydance has pledged to release at least 30 theatrical films annually, with each retaining an exclusive theatrical window of at least 45 days, and will continue to commission content from independent production companies and license works to third parties. The company also stated that its two streaming services will gradually be integrated into one service. Skydance 承诺每年至少推出 30 部院线电影，每部保留至少 45 天的院线独占窗口，并继续向独立制片公司订购内容、向第三方授权作品。公司还表示，旗下两项流媒体服务将逐步整合为一个服务。

item.title: 庵野秀明新作《宇宙战舰大和号 √2199》确认制作
item.guid: 庵野秀明新作《宇宙战舰大和号-√2199》确认制作
item.description:
Production I.G announced that the theatrical feature animation 'Space Battleship Yamato √2199' has officially entered production. Hideaki Anno serves as planner, executive producer, and co-director, while Yutaka Izubuchi serves as co-director and designer; the animation is a first-time joint production between Production I.G and khara. Production I.G 宣布，剧场长篇动画《宇宙战舰大和号 √2199》正式进入制作。庵野秀明担任企划、制作总指挥和共同监督，出渊裕担任共同监督及设计师；动画由 Production I.G 与 khara 首次联合制作。

The news was released on October 6, coinciding with the 52nd anniversary of the original 'Space Battleship Yamato' broadcast. The first concept visual shows the battleship rising from a desolate Earth. The work's title retains the mathematical symbol '√', and its Japanese reading, as noted on the official website, is 'Root 2199'. 消息在 10 月 6 日公开，正值原版《宇宙战舰大和号》开播 52 周年。首张概念视觉图呈现战舰从荒废的地球升起的场景。作品标题保留数学符号「√」，官网标注的日文读法为「ルート 2199」。

The original work, which premiered on October 6, 1974, tells the story of humanity piloting a space battleship to Iscandar in search of a way to save Earth; Anno's new work will be presented as a theatrical feature animation. 1974 年 10 月 6 日开播的原作讲述人类驾驶宇宙战舰前往伊斯坎达尔，寻找拯救地球的方法；庵野此次的新作将以剧场长篇动画形式呈现。

item.title: AI 电影 Gods Don’t Give Gifts 延至 12 月上映，计划申报奥斯卡
item.guid: AI-电影-Gods-Don’t-Give-Gifts-延至-12-月上映，计划申报奥斯卡
item.description:
According to Variety, AI studio Fable has adjusted the U.S. release date for the film 'Gods Don’t Give Gifts' from October 30 to December 4, and plans to submit it for consideration for the Academy Award for Best Animated Feature. The film's trailer will hit theaters this Friday, and promotional posters will also be distributed to multiplex cinemas across the U.S. 据 Variety 报道，AI 工作室 Fable 将电影 Gods Don’t Give Gifts 的美国上映日从 10 月 30 日调整到 12 月 4 日，并计划申报奥斯卡最佳动画长片。影片预告将于本周五进入影院，宣传海报也将铺向美国多厅影院。

The film is produced by YouTube creator Gossip Goblin, whose real name is Zack London, and comprises four short films. The story is set in the second cycle of his fictional world, 'The Thirteen Cycles of Humanity': after humanity transcends limitations such as death and memory through technology, they confront their own situation anew, thereby satirizing the relationship between society and AI. 影片由 YouTube 创作者 Gossip Goblin，原名 Zack London，制作，集合四个短片。故事设置在其虚构世界「人类十三个周期」中的第二个周期：人类借助技术跨越死亡和记忆等限制后，重新面对自身处境，以此讽刺社会与 AI 的关系。

Fable is arranging advance screenings for Academy members and critics, and will run advertisements in Los Angeles next month to promote it for awards season. London stated that AI allowed him and a small team to bring a vast fictional world to the screen; he also hopes that audiences will take the story's premise seriously before following it to its bizarre, humorous, or sad consequences. Fable 准备安排学院成员和影评人提前观看，并于下月在洛杉矶投放广告，为颁奖季展开宣传。London 称，AI 让他与一个小团队把规模庞大的虚构世界搬上银幕；他也希望观众认真看待故事的前提，再跟随它走向怪诞、幽默或悲伤的后果。
